content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect configuration of the SP804 timer clocks in the device tree for the ARM64 Juno board. The SP804 timer was not receiving the correct clock sources, which led to issues with its functionality. The patch adds support for the SP810 System Controller, which generates the necessary clock signals (32kHz and 1MHz) and correctly configures the SP804 timer to use these clocks, thereby fixing the clock frequency issue.
